workarounds.symptom: exit 23 "0 option groups rendered" with GFLOW_CLI_BROWSER_ENGINE=patchright is the pinned patchright 1.61.2 .last.count() bug, not Flow UI drift
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(deps): bump patchright extra to 1.64.4 so .last locators resolve (#1319). Target files: pyproject.toml, .github/workflows/ci.yml, tests/api/test_engine_locator_contract.py. With `GFLOW_CLI_BROWSER_ENGINE=patchright`, every generation on flow.google.com failed with exit 23 "0 option groups rendered" before submit. Flow's UI had not changed. The cause is the pinned `patchright==1.61.2`: in that release, `locator.last` and `locator.nth(-1)` count `0` whenever exactly one element matches. The migrated composer resolves it... (Ref: https://github.com/ffroliva/gflow-cli/pull/1321)

Fix: fix(transports): locale-invariant count selector for settings pane (#1312). Target files: scripts/dev/spike_1312_count_locale.py, src/gflow_cli/api/transports/_mc_common.py, src/gflow_cli/api/transports/_mc_settings_pane.py. Fixes UiSelectorDriftError (exit 23) in the migrated host settings pane when driving non-English accounts (e.g. German hl=de). (Ref: https://github.com/ffroliva/gflow-cli/pull/1315)
